Sparklight: national footprint

Sparklight across all 24 states it operates in (2.3M residential locations). Rollout tracks its wireline vs 5G fixed-wireless build; Anchor footprint shows how competition arrived inside its territory; Competition maps wireline choice everywhere. County-level; percentages are shares of BDC residential-serviceable locations at the FCC 100/20 Mbps benchmark, within the selected Geography — switch it to Nationwide and a regional operator will read as 0%.

scroll to zoom · drag to pan

Each county is colored by its dominant class; legend shares are location-weighted by county. The stat cards up top are the location-exact headline numbers. Grey = outside the selection or the provider's footprint.

County-level (2020). Denominator = residential-serviceable locations filed among Cable / FTTP / Licensed Fixed Wireless. Copper/DSL not loaded. FWA is modeled and capacity-constrained. Provider list = filers active in ≥2 states with ≥25k national locations. Providers are keyed by FCC provider_id — a holding company that files under several IDs appears as separate entries. Sources: FCC BDC fixed availability (48 states × 8 vintages) · Census TIGER/Line 2020 counties.
